decision_conditions: <p>The proposed rear extension, by reason of its height, scale and siting, would give rise to adverse impacts in terms of daylight/sunlight and overbearing impact to neighbours, contrary to Policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), Policies D3 (Optimising Site Potential Through a Design Led Approach) and D6 (Housing Quality and Standards) of the London Plan (2021) and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document 2009.</p>

<p>The proposed extended upper floor balcony, by reason of its increased depth and location, would harmfully&nbsp; exacerbate levels of overlooking and loss of privacy to neighbouring residents, contrary to Policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), Policy D3 (Optimising Site Potential Through a Design Led Approach) and D6 (Housing Quality and Standards) of the London Plan (2021) and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document 2009.</p>

<p>The proposed rear extension, by reason of its height, scale, materiality and siting, would give rise to adverse impacts in terms of light pollution, to the detriment of the amenity of adjoining residential properties, contrary to Policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020).</p>

<p>The proposed extension, by reason of the position, scale, detailed design and bulk, would result in incongruous, discordant and uncharacteristic addition that fails to respect the character and appearance of the host dwellings and the wider terrace. As such the proposal is contrary to policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach) and D4 (Delivering good design) of the London Plan (2021) and policy LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and the guidance contained within Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).&nbsp;</p>
description: Proposed ground floor single storey rear extension and a side glass roof wraparound extension to mid terraced house.
